title: [Main]- Project Planning Lines are created in reverse order when purchase line descriptions are copied
summary: Fix project planning lines being created in reverse order when posting purchase invoices with copy line descriptions enabled.
key_points: Project Planning Lines now maintain original purchase line sequence instead of appearing in reverse (3,2,1 instead of 1,2,3)
Issue occurred when 'Copy Line Descr. to G/L Entry' setting was enabled in Purchases & Payables Setup
Root cause was Invoice Posting Buffer processing groups in descending source line number order
Solution adds ascending sort by source line number before processing the buffer
Does not affect G/L Entry, VAT Entry, or Job Ledger Entry posting
quote: Project Planning Lines are created in reverse order when purchase line descriptions are copied
